name: Wriggling Malice
source:
Mars comes England for a certain purpose. He disguises himself and joins a smuggling organization to acquire something of great importance. Eventually he meets host John.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
火星出于某种目的来到英格兰。他乔装打扮，加入了一个走私组织，以获取重要的东西。最终他遇到了主持人约翰。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
